title: Exact compatible Mayer Vietoris maps for supplied canonical open diagrams
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder, $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ an inverse diagram of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and $c$ a cone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $F_i$ be abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] on $D_i$, with inverse-image transitions $\varphi_f:D(f^{\mathrm{op}})^*F_i\to F_j$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] satisfying the canonical identity and composition equations. Let $G:I\to\operatorname{Ab}(c.pt_{\acute et})$ have isomorphisms $eG_i:G_i\cong c_i^*F_i$ and arrows conjugate to the inverse-image composition comparison followed by $c_j^*\varphi_f$. Let $L$ be a cocone on $G$. Fix a scheme $X$, $i_0\in I$, $g_0:D_{i_0}\to X$ and opens $U,V\subseteq X$ covering the image of $g_0$. For each $W\in\{U,V,U\cap V\}$ put $J=I_{\ge i_0}$, $W_j=(D(j\to i_0);g_0)^{-1}W$ and $W_L=(c_{i_0};g_0)^{-1}W$. The restricted transition $W_k\to W_j$ and projection $W_L\to W_j$ are the restrictions of the original maps. Their coefficient maps are the inverse-image composition comparisons followed by the restrictions of $\varphi_f$ or $(eG_j)^{-1};L_j$, respectively. Write $T_W^n(f)$ and $\lambda_W^n(j)$ for the resulting maps on cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology, def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback], namely pullback followed by the cohomology map of that coefficient map. Suppose for every degree the diagrams $K_U,K_V,K_{U\cap V}$ and legs $\iota_U,\iota_V,\iota_{U\cap V}$ are supplied with the canonical object, arrow and leg formulas above. Fix $q\ge0$. Let $H:I\to\operatorname{Ab}$ be specified objectwise as $H^{q+1}(D_i,F_i)$ with canonical arrows; let $B$ be its canonical cocone identified with $H^{q+1}(c.pt,L.pt)$. Put $BP_n=H^n(W_{L,U},L|)\times H^n(W_{L,V},L|)$, $BI=H^q(W_{L,U\cap V},L|)$, and let $r':B.pt\to BP_{q+1}$ be the actual pair of restriction maps. There are natural maps $a:K_U^q\oplus K_V^q\to K_{U\cap V}^q$, $b:K_{U\cap V}^q\to tH$, $r:tH\to K_U^{q+1}\oplus K_V^{q+1}$, bottom maps $a':BP_q\to BI$, $b':BI\to B.pt$, and cocone legs $\iota_1,\iota_4$ into $BP_q,BP_{q+1}$. The stage pairs $(a_j,b_j)$ and $(b_j,r_j)$ and bottom pair $(a',b')$ are exact. The three stage-leg squares commute. Each product cocone leg composed with the first or second projection is the corresponding biproduct projection followed by $\iota_U$ or $\iota_V$. Here $t:J\to I$ is the tail inclusion. No geometry or coefficient colimit, compactness, certificate, finality or group colimit is asserted.

proof.text: The two inverse-image opens cover every tail stage and the limit. Choose the functorial Mayer Vietoris boundary transformations before evaluating on sheaves. Transport the restrictions, differences and boundaries to the concrete Sheaf.H groups using restriction comparisons and resolution independence.

Coefficient naturality and pullback naturality of the same sequence produce the natural stage transformations and all three stage-leg squares. Conjugate by the supplied isomorphisms; hB identifies the middle cocone leg. The exact sequences give the specified stage and bottom pairs. Pair the canonical single-open legs using the biproduct universal property; this gives the four projection formulas.

theorem etale_limit_open_mayerVietoris_maps
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U V : X.Opens)
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D)
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
    (G : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (F i))
    (hG : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), G.map f =
      (eG i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (φ f) ≫ (eG j).inv)
    (L : Cocone G) (q : ℕ)
    (H : I ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eH : ∀ i : I, H.obj i ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H (F i) (q + 1)))
    (hH : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), H.map f =
      (eH i).hom ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (cohomologyMap (D.map f.op) (F i) (q + 1)) ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Sheaf.H.map (φ f) (q + 1)) ≫ (eH j).inv)
    (B : Cocone H) (eB : B.pt ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H L.pt (q + 1)))
    (hB : ∀ i : I, B.ι.app i ≫ eB.hom =
      (eH i).hom ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (cohomologyMap (c.π.app (op i)) (F i) (q + 1)) ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Sheaf.H.map ((eG i).inv ≫ L.ι.app i) (q + 1)))
    (i₀ : I) (g₀ : D.obj (op i₀) ⟶ X)
    (hcover : g₀ ⁻¹ᵁ (U ⊔ V) = ⊤)
    (KU : ℕ → Set.Ici i₀ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eKU : ∀ n j, (KU n).obj j ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (tailStageOpen D g₀ U j).ι).obj (F j.val)) n))
    (hKU : ∀ n j k (f : j ⟶ k), (KU n).map f =
      (eKU n j).hom ≫ tailOpenCohomologyMapDegree D g₀ U F φ n f ≫ (eKU n k).inv)
    (ιU : ∀ n, KU n ⟶ (Functor.const (Set.Ici i₀)).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ((c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀) ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).obj L.pt) n)))
    (hιU : ∀ n j, (ιU n).app j =
      (eKU n j).hom ≫ tailOpenCohomologyLegDegree D c g₀ U F G eG L n j)
    (KV : ℕ → Set.Ici i₀ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eKV : ∀ n j, (KV n).obj j ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (tailStageOpen D g₀ V j).ι).obj (F j.val)) n))
    (hKV : ∀ n j k (f : j ⟶ k), (KV n).map f =
      (eKV n j).hom ≫ tailOpenCohomologyMapDegree D g₀ V F φ n f ≫ (eKV n k).inv)
    (ιV : ∀ n, KV n ⟶ (Functor.const (Set.Ici i₀)).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ((c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀) ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).obj L.pt) n)))
    (hιV : ∀ n j, (ιV n).app j =
      (eKV n j).hom ≫ tailOpenCohomologyLegDegree D c g₀ V F G eG L n j)
    (KI : ℕ → Set.Ici i₀ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eKI : ∀ n j, (KI n).obj j ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (tailStageOpen D g₀ (U ⊓ V) j).ι).obj (F j.val)) n))
    (hKI : ∀ n j k (f : j ⟶ k), (KI n).map f =
      (eKI n j).hom ≫ tailOpenCohomologyMapDegree D g₀ (U ⊓ V) F φ n f ≫ (eKI n k).inv)
    (ιI : ∀ n, KI n ⟶ (Functor.const (Set.Ici i₀)).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ((c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀) ⁻¹ᵁ (U ⊓ V)).ι).obj L.pt) n)))
    (hιI : ∀ n j, (ιI n).app j =
      (eKI n j).hom ≫ tailOpenCohomologyLegDegree D c g₀ (U ⊓ V) F G eG L n j)
 :
    let t : Set.Ici i₀ ⥤ I :=
      (show Monotone (fun j : Set.Ici i₀ ↦ j.val) from fun _ _ h ↦ h).functor
    let WU := (c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀) ⁻¹ᵁ U
    let WV := (c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀) ⁻¹ᵁ V
    let WI := (c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀) ⁻¹ᵁ (U ⊓ V)
    let BI := AddCommGrpCat.of
      (Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} WI.ι).obj L.pt) q)
    let BP := fun n ↦ AddCommGrpCat.of
      (Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} WU.ι).obj L.pt) n ×
        Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} WV.ι).obj L.pt) n)
    let r' : B.pt ⟶ BP (q + 1) := AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
      (((cohomologyMap WU.ι L.pt (q + 1)).prod
        (cohomologyMap WV.ι L.pt (q + 1))).comp eB.hom.hom)
    ∃ (a : KU q ⊞ KV q ⟶ KI q) (b : KI q ⟶ t ⋙ H)
      (r : t ⋙ H ⟶ KU (q + 1) ⊞ KV (q + 1))
      (a' : BP q ⟶ BI) (b' : BI ⟶ B.pt)
      (ι₁ : KU q ⊞ KV q ⟶ (Functor.const (Set.Ici i₀)).obj (BP q))
      (ι₄ : KU (q + 1) ⊞ KV (q + 1) ⟶
        (Functor.const (Set.Ici i₀)).obj (BP (q + 1))),
      (∀ j, Function.Exact (a.app j) (b.app j)) ∧
      (∀ j, Function.Exact (b.app j) (r.app j)) ∧ Function.Exact a' b' ∧
      (∀ j, a.app j ≫ (ιI q).app j = ι₁.app j ≫ a') ∧
      (∀ j, b.app j ≫ B.ι.app j.val = (ιI q).app j ≫ b') ∧
      (∀ j, r.app j ≫ ι₄.app j = B.ι.app j.val ≫ r') ∧
      (∀ j, ι₁.app j ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (AddMonoidHom.fst _ _) =
        (biprod.fst : KU q ⊞ KV q ⟶ KU q).app j ≫ (ιU q).app j) ∧
      (∀ j, ι₁.app j ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (AddMonoidHom.snd _ _) =
        (biprod.snd : KU q ⊞ KV q ⟶ KV q).app j ≫ (ιV q).app j) ∧
      (∀ j, ι₄.app j ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (AddMonoidHom.fst _ _) =
        (biprod.fst : KU (q + 1) ⊞ KV (q + 1) ⟶ KU (q + 1)).app j ≫ (ιU (q + 1)).app j) ∧
      (∀ j, ι₄.app j ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (AddMonoidHom.snd _ _) =
        (biprod.snd : KU (q + 1) ⊞ KV (q + 1) ⟶ KV (q + 1)).app j ≫ (ιV (q + 1)).app j)
